subject: Request: Keep pilot active while PO processes (LumenHealth)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood-inference.com, grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot continuity while PO clears — LumenHealth

Alex — happy Friday. Quick follow from our demo last week. I checked in with Finance/Legal and understand your PO is routed but still awaiting signatures on the vendor onboarding side. We don’t want your evaluation to lose momentum while procurement finishes up.

Can we do a short bridge to keep your pilot environment live? Proposed options:
- 7-day keepalive with a 5k token credit (no charge)
- 14-day keepalive with a conditional 10k token credit, auto-revoked if PO isn’t submitted by day 10

If either works, we’ll provision the credit today and share a short DocuSign to formalize the temporary grant. We’ll also add a simple acceptance clause that the credits are contingent on an in-flight PO and will be zero-cost if LumenHealth signs the attached SOW.

If you can share an expected PO clearance date (even a ballpark), I’ll coordinate with our CS team to size the credits appropriately and set up a weekly sync. Dylan and Grace are looped to help during onboarding and to make the technical handoff seamless.

Best —
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood-inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0190
Redwood Inference — production-ready LLM inference

Attachments: lumen_SOW_v1.pdf (stub)

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lumenhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Paula Jensen <paula.jensen@lumenhealth.com>, procurement@lumenhealth.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot continuity while PO clears — LumenHealth

Thanks, Irene. Really appreciate the proactive option. Our procurement team moved the PO to signatures late yesterday but Legal has asked for an additional compliance doc which slowed things down. Current ETA from procurement is between 10–14 business days.

If you can do the 7-day 5k token option today, that would help keep the demo active while we finish internal approvals. Also: can you clarify what happens to unused tokens if the PO completes within the bridge window? Will they convert or be reconciled?

If you can send the DocuSign and the short terms we can get an internal sponsor to acknowledge it ASAP.

—Alex
Alex Rivera
Lead Product Manager, Clinical AI | LumenHealth
alex.rivera@lumenhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-3322

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood-inference.com, grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:52:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot continuity while PO clears — LumenHealth

Alex — thanks for the update and the clarity on procurement timing. Quick answers:
- Unused tokens during the bridge: if PO is fully executed within the bridge window we will either (a) apply unused trial tokens as a one-time credit to the first invoice up to the value provided, or (b) roll them into a pre-paid credit bucket for the initial month — whichever your finance prefers. We will not charge you for the trial credit itself.
- If PO isn’t completed by the bridge end, the trial credit expires; we’ll pause the environment to avoid unexpected usage.

I’m attaching a short two-page bridge agreement (trial-bridge-agreement.docx) and will route a DocuSign with the 7-day 5k credit option selected unless you confirm otherwise. The DocuSign will include: HubSpot deal id, conditional credit clause, and a one-sentence acceptance from your internal sponsor.

Dylan — can you confirm the token bucket activation steps and monitor usage? Grace — can you take point on the technical handoff once the credit is active?

Alex — if you can ask your sponsor to sign the DocuSign (I’ll send it in 30 minutes) we’ll provision the tokens immediately upon signature. If procurement needs the DocuSign included in the PO packet for traceability, let me know and I’ll send a PDF as well.

Thanks —
Irene

Attachments: trial-bridge-agreement.docx (stub)
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567?dealId=4532

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lumenhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: procurement@lumenhealth.com, Paula Jensen <paula.jensen@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot continuity while PO clears — LumenHealth

Irene — Paula (Finance) signed the quick acknowledgement internally and procurement confirmed they’ll include the DocuSign in the PO packet. Procurement also asked for invoice terms: net-30 is preferred; is that acceptable?

We’ll sign the DocuSign this afternoon. Appreciate the 7-day bridge — that should keep things running while we close out legal.

—Alex
